task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Implement VQE in Qiskit for the 3-site transverse-field Ising model H = -J*sum(Z_i Z_{i+1}) - h*sum(X_i) with J=0.87, h=1.16 (open boundary). Use StatevectorEstimator with a TwoLocal-style ansatz and scipy, and compare with exact diagonalization. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
